name: AI Arkanoid LG
content:
AI Arkanoid LG is a panoramic multiplayer brick-breaker built for Liquid Galaxy.

The court is rendered across every screen of the rig by a Node.js and Socket.IO server that serves a Phaser web client. Each player joins from their own Android phone using this Flutter controller. The same app can open and close Chromium on the wall over SSH so a match does not need the master keyboard.

Features:
- One continuous court across 3, 5, 7, 9 or 12 frames
- Phone paddle only — the wall is always Chromium + Node on port 8130
- Host picks match length, player count and ball speed, and can start with one paddle
- QR join from the center screen (the join code is never on /health)
- SSH connect, auto-detect screen count from personavars.txt, launch and close
- Gemini live commentary, with offline lines when the key is unset

This project was developed as a GESOC 2026 (Gemini Summer of Code) project with the Liquid Galaxy Project Organization.

Contributor: Anirudh Pratap Singh Yadav
